result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new matches (`.htm`, `*.xml`, `*.js`, `*-gradle.js`). The existing convention and scoping tests pass, but they don't exercise these patterns.

- **pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules:** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **`<doc>` XML rule and `// Generated by` JS rule:** the path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` required a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match.
- **Gradle JS rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` is in the build-and-deployment scope. `.*[.]gradle`, which covers `build.gradle`, was already separate and is unchanged.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files have no matching content line, so they stay out of the generated scope.
